evidence.evidenceSummary: User interviews and competitor analysis support the existence of this problem.

knownFacts: Users report spending 4 hours per week on manual data entry.
assumptions: Automation can reduce manual entry time by 80%.
unknowns: Whether users will trust automated classification.

riskNotes: Market window may close within 6 months.

prd.problemStatement: Small business owners spend too much time on manual data entry instead of serving customers.
nonGoals: Enterprise ERP integration is out of scope.
prd.scope: Manual data entry automation for small service businesses.
successCriteria: Users complete data entry tasks in under 10 minutes per day.
